JQ-01

What is PAHAD AI?

[FUSED / MODELLED]

PAHAD AI is the dual-engine geotechnical early warning AI of PARVAT NETRA, pairing deterministic infinite-slope physical mechanics (Factor of Safety, FoS) with calibrated machine learning (GradientBoostingClassifier) and multimodal telemetry.

Detailed Defense: Treats slope stability as limit-equilibrium physics (tau_f / tau_d) rather than a pure black-box classifier. Fuses FoS, 24h P(event), 72h antecedent rainfall, and satellite InSAR deformation into the Composite Risk Index (CRI [0-100]).

Code: engine/pahad_engine.py, engine/pahad_event_predictor.py, engine/pahad_live_inference.py

Uncompromising Limitation: Model status is TRAINED_LIMITED_DATA (calibrated on 17 historical failures, 19 controls; research prototype).

JQ-02

What is CRI?

[FUSED]

The Composite Risk Index (CRI) is a bounded [0, 100] multi-criteria hazard aggregation synthesizing geotechnical FoS, antecedent precipitation, satellite InSAR deformation, and seismo-tectonic acceleration.

Detailed Defense: Stratified into STABLE (<30), WATCH (30-50), WARNING (50-70), and CRITICAL (≥70). Every CRI score decomposes into an immutable ExplanationContract showing modality percentages—never a single black-box score.

Code: engine/pahad_live_inference.py:calculate_composite_risk_index

Limitation: Weight coefficients are calibrated on Eastern Himalayan steep schists and phyllites.

JQ-03

Why FoS?

[PHYSICS]

Factor of Safety (FoS) enforces Newtonian limit-equilibrium physical laws, preventing machine learning from hallucinating false landslides on mechanically impossible slopes.

Detailed Defense: Formulated via infinite-slope Mohr-Coulomb equation: FoS = [c' + (γ z cos²β - u) tanφ'] / [γ z sinβ cosβ]. Guarantees that slope geometry, cohesion, friction angle, and pore pressure govern failure. If FoS > 1.5, slope collapse is mechanically impossible regardless of sensor noise.

Code: engine/pahad_engine.py:calculate_factor_of_safety

Limitation: Models 1D translational infinite slope; 3D rotational slip requires localized borehole logs.

JQ-04

Why ML?

[CALIBRATED ML]

Machine learning captures non-linear antecedent rainfall saturation, seismic weakening, and multi-day temporal forecast horizons that static geotechnical formulas omit.

Detailed Defense: Classical FoS evaluates instantaneous stability without predictive lead time. Our calibrated GradientBoostingClassifier evaluates non-linear multi-variate interactions across 6h, 12h, 24h, and 48h horizons with probability calibration (Platt scaling / Brier score = 0.082).

Code: engine/pahad_event_predictor.py:predict_event_probability

Limitation: Calibrated strictly on documented historical events (TRAINED_LIMITED_DATA).

JQ-05

Why not LSTM?

[NOT_TRAINED / SURROGATE]

PARVAT NETRA strictly rejects deep learning theater: current historical catalogs lack dense continuous sequence telemetry, so claiming an LSTM was trained would be scientifically fraudulent.

Detailed Defense: Historical GSI landslide catalogs contain temporal timestamp uncertainty of ±6h to 24h and sparse observation intervals. Under engine/pahad_temporal_gate.py, training recurrent models is blocked under the hard gate DATA_COLLECTION_REQUIRED. The engine/pahad_lstm.py module is explicitly identified as an unweighted physics-informed temporal surrogate.

Code: engine/pahad_temporal_gate.py, engine/pahad_lstm.py

Limitation: LSTM training is blocked until 12+ months of continuous IoT telemetry is collected.

JQ-06

What is live?

[LIVE]

Live data comprises authenticated, real-time public feeds: Open-Meteo NWP weather, USGS and NCS global/regional seismology, PostGIS mountain road routing, and local SQLite stores.

Detailed Defense: Verified by LiveDataStatusAuditor in engine/pahad_explanation_engine.py. Live feeds are polled asynchronously with automatic in-memory caching and freshness timestamps.

Code: engine/pahad_explanation_engine.py:LiveDataStatusAuditor

Limitation: Upstream third-party rate limits and external internet latency.

JQ-07

What is simulated?

[SIMULATED / DISCLOSED]

In-situ borehole sensors, physical siren hardware, and offline institutional feeds are transparently badged as [SIMULATED] or [AUTH_REQUIRED]—never fabricated as live.

Detailed Defense: Physical in-situ borehole piezometers/inclinometers are explicitly marked [SIMULATED] (deployment is 'NOT VERIFIED'). IMD radar is marked [AUTH_REQUIRED]. Sentinel-1 InSAR is marked [HISTORICAL / PROCESSED]. Zero fabricated hardware connectivity.

Code: engine/pahad_explanation_engine.py:get_provider_truth_audit

Limitation: Full physical deployment requires capital hardware installation by state authorities.

JQ-08

How do you prevent false alerts?

[HEURISTIC • 2-OF-3]

False alerts are prevented via 2-of-3 Multi-Signal Corroboration, temporal persistence checks, and statutory human District Disaster Management Authority authorization.

Detailed Defense: Requires convergence of at least two independent domains: [A] Geotechnical (FoS < 1.15), [B] Hydrological (24h rain > 75mm), [C] InSAR subsidence (< -10mm/yr). A single outlier sensor cannot trigger an alert. Furthermore, statutory human review is mandatory under DMA 2005.

Code: engine/pahad_explanation_engine.py:evaluate_corroboration

Limitation: Cloud cover and radar shadow in deep valleys can introduce latency in InSAR validation.

JQ-09

Can AI trigger the siren?

[SAFETY LOCKED]

ABSOLUTELY NOT. Under the Disaster Management Act 2005 and NDMA guidelines, autonomous AI actuation of public emergency sirens is strictly illegal and permanently locked out.

Detailed Defense: Hard locks: ENABLE_PUBLIC_DISPATCH=0, SIREN_DRY_RUN=1, PUBLIC_DEMO_TEST_ONLY=1. Any actuation command via Voice AI or unauthenticated API returns REJECTED_SAFETY under DMA 2005 Sections 30 & 34.

Code: services/pahad_voice_assistant.py, app.py:dispatch_siren

Limitation: Requires authenticated human Incident Commander sign-off.

JQ-10

What is your biggest limitation?

[HONEST DISCLOSURE]

Our primary limitation is the lack of physical, high-density in-situ borehole sensor telemetry deployed continuously across all 300+ Northeast highway corridors.

Detailed Defense: Currently, in-situ borehole piezometers/inclinometers are simulated via Mohr-Coulomb mechanics because physical field hardware is 'NOT VERIFIED'. Furthermore, the statistical event classifier is calibrated on 17 historical failures (TRAINED_LIMITED_DATA / research prototype).

Code: docs/PAHAD_MODEL_CARD.md, engine/pahad_temporal_gate.py

Limitation: Full statewide operational rollout requires capital expenditure by BRO/NDMA.
